title: Document and centralize SQL identifier quoting in checkpoint restore
description: Tech-debt review finding. materialize in store.ts concatenates quoted SQL identifiers from snapshot data and forkCampaign.ts builds DELETE FROM from a hardcoded list. Safe today with trusted inputs. Add an explicit trust-assumption comment and a shared quoteIdent helper, and replace the magic temp-file suffix with a named constant. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
